description: Not for a file attached in this chat: that goes to visarun_upload_document's file. A one-time page where the person uploads one document from their phone or computer without signing in: for a chat that cannot send the file. Give the person url and say it works once, for 30 minutes. When they say it is uploaded, call visarun_upload_document with upload_page_id: it is read and put in its field as any other upload. document_type and field_key from the fields call (documents.items[]). For a passport page field (a cover, a last page) with no page of its own (none found, or the one cut read nothing, failed or was never read) while the passport field holds a PDF, the page shows that PDF's pages as thumbnails and the person taps the one the field takes (picks_page: true): tell them so; after they say it is done, visarun_upload_document with upload_page_id puts that page in the field.
name: visarun_create_upload_page
title: Create a one-time upload page
